findings.issue: «la» is a definite article. Morph is an interrogative particle (HTi), while the lemma is prefixed d/; the he is not unambiguous, and «la» may add definiteness.
Sequential perfect 2mp is rendered as an ustedes imperative. Person, number, hithpael reflexive force, and qal «take» stay intact; only mood is smoothed.

notes: Fat/lean, one tree, from the fruit of the land, and the repeated days of firstfruits of grapes stay inside the tokens.
